info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows users to withdraw submitted career applications, ensuring that applicants can manage their application status effectively. By utilizing this endpoint, users can remove their applications from consideration, which is particularly useful in dynamic job search scenarios. Typically employed by job seekers and HR systems, this API streamlines the process of managing applications, enhancing user control and flexibility in the recruitment workflow.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows users to withdraw their application, effectively removing it from consideration. This action is irreversible and should be confirmed by the user before proceeding.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to withdraw an application. It must contain the necessary details to identify the application to be withdrawn.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: The request body for withdrawing an application.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.title: Withdraw Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the withdrawal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: Current state of the application after withdrawal.

processingTimeMs.description: Total time taken for the processing of the withdrawal request in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message about the result of the withdrawal operation.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the successful withdrawal of an application.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Name or identifier of the user or system that created the request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the withdrawal request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal request was generated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the creation and processing of the withdrawal request.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
